text:
lina-ps: Heads up - BrightFarms POC hit repeated 503s during an interactive walkthrough. Demo was at ~14:30. They ran a batch of high-concurrency chat sessions and saw timeouts. Need quick triage.

jo-sales: Customer on call saw 503s and some sessions reset. They were testing 8 concurrent streams with ~5k token context. They asked if this is an SLA issue.

matt-se: Can you share logs and whether they pinned to a GPU pool?

lina-ps: Logs pasted below. We also have the user-provided request pattern (8 conc, seq=5k, streaming:true).

```
[2026-03-20T14:30:10Z] inference-node-3: error id=9f3cde code=503 reason="capacity_throttle" msg="burst_pool_exhausted"
[2026-03-20T14:30:11Z] router: 502 upstream=inference-node-3 reason="connection_reset"
[2026-03-20T14:30:13Z] autoscaler: pending=18 active=3 target=5 cooldown=60s
[2026-03-20T14:30:15Z] runtime: fallback attempt rwd-medium-quant -> rejected (tag=private-gpu required)
[2026-03-20T14:30:45Z] ops-bot: notice: burst_pool increased from 4->12 for project=brightfarms-poc by oz-sre
```

oz-sre: looks similar to prior POCs - autoscale cooldown still at 60s for this org. I'll bump burst_pool and lower cooldown for the demo window.

cal-eng-runtime: another factor: KV cache pressure observed, long ongoing gens held more memory and prevented reuse, so effective capacity lower. We should consider limiting max concurrent generations for streaming demos or enable prefix caching.

jo-sales: Customer wants a quick explanation for post-demo: why did 503s happen and what we did? Also wants any cost numbers for bumping pool during demos.

matt-se: Quick reply draft: "The 503s occurred because the demo produced a sudden burst of long-running generation requests that exhausted the temporary burst capacity before autoscaling could provision more nodes. We increased the burst pool and shortened autoscale cooldown to restore service. For reliable production behavior we recommend Dedicated capacity or pre-warmed instances."

oz-sre: Applied changes at 14:31:05 - burst_pool 4->12, cooldown 15s. ops-bot logged change above. After that, one more 502 at 14:31:20 then stable.

lina-ps: Customer resumed and completed demo. They still asked: is there a recommended config snippet for POC to avoid this?

cal-eng-runtime: suggest snippet and note tradeoffs:
```
project: brightfarms-poc
burst_pool: 12
autoscale:
  cooldown_seconds: 15
  max_scale_up: 6
limits:
  max_concurrent_generations: 6
fallback:
  allow_cross_pool: false  # if security requires pinned pool
```

jo-sales: can we provide a one-paragraph non-technical note about 503s for the customer email?

matt-se: sure: "Short, customer-friendly note: We observed transient 5xx errors during your demo caused by a short burst of unusually heavy requests (many long-running chat sessions at once). We temporarily increased capacity and tuned scaling to recover quickly. For production-level stability we can provision Dedicated capacity or schedule pre-warmed nodes for demos."

oz-sre: follow-up todo: run a staged replay with 8 concurrent streams, 5k tokens, streaming enabled to validate cooldown=15s. I'll post results tomorrow.

lina-ps: thanks all. I'll send the follow-up email now and cc eng/sre.

jo-sales: thanks team — customer appreciated the quick response. :thumbsup:
